reviews.text: Great groomers for our Australian Persian cat. Love how friendly they are and the ‘lion cut’ looks fabulous!

iPaw Pet Salon Evans Rd groomer salon has been consistent with dog grooming results, easily a 5-stars. my precious loved, cared for pup is at ease, comfortable, and safe. the groomer is very hands-on and attentive to requests of customers. the Air Force Veteran- owner, Sebastian of this previous family business, is very meticulous, and present managing hands-on every day. he really cares for the satisfaction of his every customer. i couldnt go to any other grooming place after coming here.

Today was the first time I brought my persian cat to IPaw Pet Salon and they did a great job.  Since his fur grows in so thick and long he needed to be de-matted.  They did a wonderful job getting out all the matting, and he came back being freshly bathed, and with a new hair cut (and with a cute bandanna!).

They also sell adorable pet toys, pet gifts (I grabbed a cute bday cake toy to give to my daughter’s dog on his next bday), brushes, etc.  It was a nice selection of items.

If you haven’t tried IPaw Pet Salon before, give them a try for your pets next salon visit!
Awesome shop

Terrible experiences at this place.
First time I brought my standard poodle in for a poodle cut and they gave her a doodle cut. She looked ridiculous, like a sheep. I didn't say anything and chalked it up to miscommunication.
I decided to give them another shot and this time I made sure to let them know that I wanted a poodle cut and tried to explain that last time she was given a doodle cut. I say "tried" because the guy at the front was rude, cutting me off, talking over me, and just raising his voice telling me that what I'm asking for is a specialty cut that will be more than their poodle cut. In all 8 years of taking my dog to the groomer I've never heard of this, it's always just been called a standard poodle cut.
Then came the price gauging. Please note that the first time I had called to get the poodle cut pricing because it's not listed on the website (says to call for pricing) and was quoted $128. That's what I was charged last time for the doodle sheep cut. The second time when I dropped her off I tried to clarify the pricing but was dismissed, brushed off, and told we'd discuss it at pickup.
Upon pickup they charged me an extra $50 on top of the poodle cut price. Nowhere on the poodle cut description or website does it say that specific poodle styles (like the Miami cut) are exceptions and carry additional costs. The groomer did a good job but the customer service by the front desk guy was atrocious.
Stay away from this place if you don't want any surprises when it comes to your dogs haircut, price of the cut, and rude service.

We took our long haired cat here anticipating he would need a shave for how bad his hair knots were. Once iPaw called us for ready for pick up we saw they did not need to shave him and was able to practically give him a full smooth coat again. He is so much happier too! We would like to add something we learned when he got home, our second cat does not recognize him due to the scent it is called non-recognition aggression so she is scared of him currently but will go away once his natural scent comes back. We definitely plan to return to iPaw once he needs grooming again.

This occurred in December 2021. My dog went in for a routine haircut. When I picked him up, they told me they had nicked him and put superglue on the injury. Because of the hair around his eyes, I couldn’t initially see its severity. By the following day, the area was badly swollen and appeared infected, so I took him to the vet. After the vet shaved the area, we discovered the significant open wound shown in these photos.

The owner paid for his veterinary treatment and has since confirmed that the employee involved was fired. I appreciate that action, but it does not change the severity of what happened to my dog. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this business.

Not only was I not informed of the staff change, the new person did a pretty bad job. When I was told prices were going to increase and I asked by how much and was told that it would be at least $25 and that the discount I was receiving (remember 6 years of loyalty) would be decreasing and the attitude was unpleasant.

Not to worry though... I have found Sarah and will now be taking Niko to her again at Fine Whines and Lickers.  So if you're a long time customer like me and didn't know the entire staff changed now you do and can find them!

We’re absolutely purr-obsessed with how our sweet boy turned out! He got a teddy bear cut and looks SO cute we can barely handle it! The service was fast, everyone was incredibly kind, and you can tell they truly care about the pets they groom. Our cat was treated like royalty and came home happy and handsome. We’ll definitely be feline our way back!

For clarity, this individual is a former employee and not a client of our business. Their statements do not reflect a customer experience and are related to an internal employment matter.

As a policy, we do not discuss personnel issues in public forums. This matter has been documented and our legal counsel has been informed.

We remain committed to providing high-quality grooming services and professional care to our clients and their pets. We encourage prospective clients to refer to reviews from verified customers regarding their actual service experience with our salon.
